cards.title: 26.2 miles
cards.text: The marathon was standardised at 42.195 km after the 1908 London Olympics, where the course reportedly ran from Windsor Castle to the royal box in the stadium.

cards.title: Golf on the Moon
cards.text: In 1971 Apollo 14 astronaut Alan Shepard hit two golf balls on the Moon using a makeshift club.

cards.question: How many rings are on the Olympic flag?
Which country hosted (and won) the first FIFA World Cup in 1930?
In tennis, what does a score of 'love' mean?
options: A serve that hits the net

cards.question: Basketball was invented in 1891 by…
cards.explanation: Naismith, a Canadian PE teacher, invented it at a YMCA school in Springfield, Massachusetts.

cards.statement: The dimples on a golf ball help it fly farther.
cards.explanation: Dimples create a thin turbulent layer that reduces drag; a smooth ball would travel much shorter.

cards.statement: The marathon distance has been 42.195 km since the ancient Greek Olympics.
cards.explanation: There was no marathon race in the ancient Olympics; the distance was fixed after the 1908 London Games.
